verdicts.reason: A: the VOLTSTRIDE box, which was the hero, has shrunk to a tiny chip in the bottom-left gutter where its logo can't be read. The 48H badge is small too, the lime panel is narrow and there is a large dead gap between the headline and the body copy. B has the same layout and the same dead gap, and its panel runs flush to the right edge with no margin, so it looks lopsided. B is slightly better because its box, badge and CTA are larger and more legible, and they overlap the panel edge in a way that reads as deliberate layering. Even so, the product is still badly demoted in B.
